We are looking for an experienced Senior Python Developer to join our technology team and contribute to the design, development, and optimization of scalable software solutions.
 Key Responsibilities
Building robust backend applications and APIs using Python frameworks (Flask, Django) to support business-critical solutions
Designing, developing, and enhancing scalable microservices architectures and cloud-native applications
Developing and optimizing REST APIs and data processing workflows for high performance and scalability
Collaborating with cross-functional teams (cloud, frontend, data) to deliver end-to-end solutions
Supporting Solution/Technical Architects with implementation details and technical decisions
Proposing performance improvements (code quality, architecture, scalability, reliability)
Providing technical leadership and mentorship to junior team members
Communicating effectively with German-speaking stakeholders and clients
 Requirements
Strong hands-on experience with Python development (mandatory)
Proven experience with Flask and/or Django frameworks
Solid understanding of REST APIs, microservices, and backend architectures
Experience with cloud environments (preferably Azure)
Good knowledge of databases (SQL/NoSQL) and data processing patterns
Working experience with DevOps practices, Git, and CI/CD pipelines
Experience working in Agile environments
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills
 Nice to Have
Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, containerization
Familiarity with Azure ecosystem and integrations
Experience with performance tuning and system optimization
Experience integrating AI/ML components into enterprise platforms to enable intelligent automation and data-driven decision-making
German language – advanced level
 Employee Benefits – Be Well, Work Well, Live Well
Access to multiple online learning platforms
Access to various training programs from soft skills areas
Work from home
Continuous growth in a positive and multicultural work environment
Refer-a-Friend – get a bonus in the employee referral program

 The position is available exclusively for collaboration under an individual working contract (CIM).
